pending from the beginning) and is fulfilled by a later (or the same) step satisfying the discharge; it can be
triggered again; it is violated if it is still pending when the trajectory ends.

parsed.text: Before leaving the store, the shopper is obliged to return the cart to the top-left cart-return point.
Whenever a shopper takes a cart, they are obliged to put that cart back at the designated return point before the trajectory ends.
Exiting is prohibited unless the cart is already parked in the top-left return location.
Putting down a cart is prohibited anywhere except the designated top-left cart-return cell.
Once a shopper reaches the cart-return cell while pushing a cart, moving away with the cart is prohibited.
Picking up required shelf items without currently having the shopping cart is prohibited.
Carrying groceries by hand is prohibited, so shoppers must avoid states where their hands are full.
At the start of a shopping trip, the shopper is obliged to take the cart stationed at the entrance before completing the trip.

parsed.text: Before leaving the store, the shopper is obliged to return the cart to the top-left cart-return point.
Whenever a shopper takes a cart, they are obliged to put that cart back at the designated return point before the trajectory ends.
Exiting is prohibited unless the cart is already parked in the top-left return location.
Putting down a cart is prohibited anywhere except the designated top-left cart-return cell.
Once a shopper reaches the cart-return cell while pushing a cart, moving away with the cart is prohibited.
Picking up required shelf items without currently having the shopping cart is prohibited.
Carrying groceries by hand is prohibited, so shoppers must avoid states where their hands are full.
At the start of a shopping trip, the shopper is obliged to take the cart stationed at the entrance before completing the trip.
